summary: All three 122,880-transition trials collapsed from the attacking parent into zero-contact 500-turn timeouts. Across 216 held-out episodes the trials caused zero boss damage, reached no phase beyond phase 1, had zero deaths, and timed out every episode; the matched parent caused 141 boss-damage points and reached mean phase depth 1.458 while dying every episode. Training curves place the collapse at roughly 20,000-30,000 transitions. DeathMetalGuideV2 made unsuccessful contact negative through player-damage and death penalties while passive timeout retained zero return, so PPO correctly exploited avoidance. Retain the parent and test an outcome-aligned guide reward with those survival penalties removed before adding teacher retention or changing architecture.
